title: The Loop
_comment: Protagonist cast for the roguelike 'The Loop' — a lone, mobility-first sword-wanderer in a light leather jerkin. Sourced entirely from the MODERN Universal-LPC generator (split-per-animation art) so it can carry the expanded platformer poses (jump, climb, run) plus a battle-ready combat_idle the classic combined set lacks. Every layer covers the full animation set (the jerkin is a recolored sleeveless shirt, chosen over classic leather armour precisely because that armour lacks combat_idle art). Every layer is fetched on demand and composited in z-order; nothing is vendored.
